metadata.name: Persona Assessment
metadata.description: 3-question assessment integrating Wealth Ladder identification with Flow journey personas

questions.question: Where are you in your flow journey?
questions.subtext: Be honest - there's no wrong answer
questions.why_we_ask: This helps us understand your current situation so we can recommend the right starting point.

options.label: Exploring from my day job
options.description: I'm employed, searching for what lights me up

options.label: Building on the side
options.description: I'm employed, growing something alongside my job

options.label: Gone solo, finding my footing
options.description: I've left employment, still building momentum

zarlo_help.opening: No worries! Let me help you figure this out.

questions.question: Are you currently getting a paycheck from an employer?
questions.yes_followup: Do you have anything going on the side - a business, freelancing, or project you're building?
questions.no_followup: Are you making money from your own thing, or still figuring that out?

questions.question: What have you created so far?
questions.subtext: Think about what you're currently offering or selling
questions.why_we_ask: This tells us where you are on the wealth ladder, so we can show you the right next steps.

options.label: Trading my time
options.description: A service where I work with clients directly

options.label: Products people buy
options.description: Digital products, software, or physical goods

questions.question: Have you ever been paid for your skills or knowledge?
questions.yes_followup: Was it custom work for each client, or the same package/product every time?
questions.no_followup: That's totally okay! 'Still discovering' is your answer - that's where everyone starts.

questions.question: What would help you find your flow?
questions.why_we_ask: This helps us prioritize what to show you first and tailor your experience.

options.label: Clarity on my path
options.description: Finally knowing what I'm meant to build

zarlo_help.opening: What keeps you up at night about your work or business?

questions.question: What frustrates you most right now?

options.answer: I don't know what to do or build
I know what to do but can't make it work
I can't get enough clients or sales
I'm maxed out and can't grow

vibe_seeker.name: Flow Seeker
vibe_seeker.description: You're at the beginning of your journey, sensing there's more to life. Your next step is discovering your unique gifts and how to share them with the world.

vibe_riser.name: Flow Finder
vibe_riser.description: You know your direction but need help monetising it. Your next step is creating an irresistible offer that people feel silly saying no to.

movement_maker.name: Movement Maker
movement_maker.description: You're making money and ready to scale. Your next step is building a product suite that maximizes your impact and cashflow.

routing.description: Routing is determined by wealth_ladder from Q2, not just persona

delivery_model.question: How do you deliver your service?
delivery_model.subtext: This helps us tailor your offer building experience

options.label: Custom for each client
options.description: Every engagement is different based on their needs

num_offers.question: How many offers do you currently sell?
num_offers.subtext: This determines whether we start with one offer or map your whole suite

options.label: Just one main thing
options.description: I focus on a single offer

options.label: A few different offers
options.description: I have multiple things I sell

options.label: One now, planning more
options.description: Starting with one, building toward a suite

offering_type.question: What type of offering do you have?
offering_type.subtext: This helps us configure your product suite correctly

options.label: Self-paced course
options.description: People go through on their own time

product_type.question: What type of products do you sell?
product_type.subtext: This helps us set up the right tracking and metrics

solution_type_guidance.question: Based on your skills, here's the fastest path to your first paying client:
solution_type_guidance.subtext: Most successful entrepreneurs start with services - you learn what works, then productize.

recommended.label: Start with a Service
recommended.description: Work directly with clients, learn what works, then turn it into a product.
recommended.why: You'll learn what clients actually need, get paid while learning, and have proven material to turn into products later.

solution_type_guidance.alternatives_intro: Already know you want to build something else?

alternatives.label: I want to create a course or program
I want to build a digital product
I want to sell physical products

warm_transitions.after_q1: Great! Now let's see what you've built...
warm_transitions.after_q3: Thanks! Here's what we learned about you...
